question_text: A 56 year old female comes to the ED complaining of moderate right eye pain, headache, and acute onset of blurry vision, which she describes as colored halos around lights. She was watching a movie at home with her husband about an hour ago when the pain began. On physical exam of her right eye, her pupil is mid-dilated and unresponsive to light. Her right eyeball is firm to pressure. Intraocular pressure (IOP) measured with tonometer is elevated at 36mmHg. Which of the following is the most appropriate emergency treatment?
